{{Quote|She didn't know the Mandalorians well then, but she did know the fleet.''"<br />"''And my father, who served with her once upon a time.|[[Merratt Jaxton]] and Sallinor Parova|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sallinor Parova]]'s '''father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Their daughter took part in the [[Lecersen Conspiracy|coup]] against Daala's control of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], [[44 ABY|three years after]] the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Conviction" />
